exposure: Robson Ten-Group Classification System (RTGCS) groups (parity, previous CS, gestational age, fetal presentation, number of fetuses)
cohort: The study included 880 deliveries at Sharda Hospital Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
finding: Groups 5 (multiparous women with previous CS) and 1 (nulliparous women at term) were identified as the predominant contributors to the elevated Caesarean section rate.
mod_finding: Targeted measures, including promoting vaginal birth after caesarean (VBAC), are suggested to help reduce unnecessary Caesarean sections.
gest_age: Term (Group 1) and preterm deliveries (Group 10) were included in the classification system analysis.
